prompts.coal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent city-builder game sprite, new proposal v2. The input image is a STRICT CAMERA AND GEOMETRY TEMPLATE. Keep its ground diamond and the orientations of its wall planes. Rebuild the subject using the camera of image 1. Orthographic dimetric 2:1 projection, azimuth 45 degrees, camera elevation 30 degrees (ground edges project at atan(0.5)=26.565 degrees on screen). No perspective or vanishing points. A square ground plane projects to a centered diamond, width exactly twice ground depth. At a square composition normalized to 1024 units use the diamond corners left (64,640), back (512,416), right (960,640), front (512,864). EVERY ground-level rectangular building foundation, flat roof edge, window row, paving seam and horizontal pipe parallel to a ground axis must follow the SAME +0.5 or -0.5 screen slope as the guide. Verticals remain vertical. View clearly from above, generous visible roof areas, two equally foreshortened facades; no frontal elevation. Replace the block with the subject while retaining the geometry. Rectangular halls MUST have FLAT ROOFS aligned with the template. Avoid a front-facing entrance on a beveled corner. Keep the two main wall faces symmetrical. Thin flush foundation, no floating terrain slab. Keep all foreground geometry above and inside the two front ground edges, no overhangs outside footprint. Crisp detailed hand-painted miniature city game aesthetic, readable at small sizes, restrained industrial colors, upper-left lighting. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no external shadow, no labels, text, watermark, smoke or clouds. Entire silhouette visible, generous transparent top margin if tall. SUBJECT: Coal-fired power station: red brick turbine hall with flat industrial roof, two tall brick smokestacks behind it, coal bunker at the side, yellow safety rails.
